response.sql: WITH sex_groups AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.SEX, '') AS sex, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM Laboratory l INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID GROUP BY COALESCE(p.SEX, '')), stats AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_records, AVG(record_count) AS avg_records_per_group FROM sex_groups), filtered_groups AS (SELECT sg.sex, sg.record_count, s.total_records, s.avg_records_per_group FROM sex_groups sg CROSS JOIN stats s WHERE sg.record_count > s.avg_records_per_group) SELECT sex, record_count, CAST(record_count AS FLOAT) / CAST(total_records AS FLOAT) AS fraction_of_total, record_count - avg_records_per_group AS above_average FROM filtered_groups
